text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You wasn't feeling well, so I 
took her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... The smell of disinfectant... It 
smells just like a hospital...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—I-I'm fine! I'll get a good night's sleep 
right here and make sure to fully recover!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... Uuuugh... It smells like a 
hospital... Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Where am—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD... THUD...)

text_block_list.name: Syringe Monster
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOHHHH--!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek!? A giant syringe, a 
monsteerrrr!?!?

text_block_list.name: Syringe Monster
text_block_list.text:
Drawing blood... drawing blood... Just a 
little prick... heh-heh-heh-heh-heh—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Noooooo, stay awaaaay!! I don't wanna be 
hurt, noooo!!!
"Loves-chaaaan!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hah—?! This voice... is that...?!

text_block_list.name: Community Members?
text_block_list.text:
"Don't give up, Loves-chan!!" "Just blast 
that syringe away!" "Hit 'em with a 
fighting game combo!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ââ!! Everyone...!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer?
text_block_list.text:
"You can even defeat a monster! After all, 
you have the power of love on your side, 
don't you?!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer?
text_block_list.text:
"‘You could even take down a monster! 
After all, you have the power of love, 
right!?’"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right... That's right... I have the power 
of everyone's love!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
All right... Time to hit 'em with a 
fighting game combo!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Syringes are... Syringes are...! Cross-up 
heavy kick into crouching punch launcher! 
Air combo finished with a landing super 
special art—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABABOOOOOOOOM!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Syringe Monster
text_block_list.text: Draw bl... blood... psshhwwoooo...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I don't need any syringes as I am now! 
With the power of love, I'm 
completely—healthy!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Damooooon... mooon...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Ha!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I won... I beat the needle...! —Because 
I'm completely healthy!!
